result.title: Entropy-Regularized Integrated Gradients for Stable Feature Attribution
result.comment: 36 pages, 19 figures, 27 tables, including the appendix
result.summary: Path-based attribution methods like Integrated Gradients (IG) are widely used to interpret neural networks, yet imperceptible input perturbations can drastically alter their attribution maps while leaving model predictions unchanged. We introduce Entropy-Regularized Integrated Gradients (ERIG), a path-based attribution method that intrinsically attenuates gradient irregularities along the integration path using maximum-entropy softmax weighting with temperature parameter $τ$. We quantify the effect of the entropy-regularized weighting on attribution stability by using the Lipschitz properties of the model and its gradients. We decompose the attribution change under an input perturbation into a model-response term, whose bound is $τ$-independent, and a weight-variation term, whose bound decreases at rate $\mathcal{O}(1/(2τ))$. Their ratio $R(τ)$ characterizes the trade-off between gradient information and attribution stability. We further add a new dimension to attribution evaluation by adapting classical noise estimators into two metrics, LINV-C and LINV-P, that quantify attribution noise. Across eleven CNN and Transformer backbones on ImageNet and Oxford-IIIT Pet datasets, our experiments show that, relative to the next-best method, ERIG remains comparable on ranking-based fidelity metrics while improving localization by approximately 24% and attribution stability by approximately 47-fold on average, reaching up to four orders of magnitude improvement over IG, all at negligible additional computational cost.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出熵正则化积分梯度（ERIG），沿积分路径用最大熵 softmax 加权抑制梯度不规则性，并用 Lipschitz 性质给出归因稳定性界，同时构造 LINV-C/LINV-P 噪声指标在 11 个 CNN 与 Transformer 骨干上评估保真度、定位与稳定性。
AI.relevance_reason: 归因路径加权与稳定性量化或可为 LVR 中「哪些视觉证据被实际使用」的贡献分配和视觉旁路诊断提供核查线索，但其研究对象是输入特征归因而非模型内部 latent 推理状态，迁移需自行判断。
